result.description: Enterprise collaboration suite (messaging, calendar, docs, video meetings, approvals, tasks, email) with a broad Open Platform API; international sibling of Feishu.
result.auth_detail: tenant_access_token (app identity, from App ID + App Secret) for automated actions. user_access_token via standard OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow (refresh tokens supported). Calls sent as Bearer tokens.
result.access_detail: Create a self-built app free in the developer console and get credentials. Scopes marked as needing review need tenant admin approval. Self-built apps work only in their own tenant. To serve other tenants, a store app is needed, which requires ISV qualification, Lark listing review, and per-tenant admin install approval. Free signup was not confirmed on the pages read, and no pricing page was checked.
result.api_notes: REST OpenAPI covers contacts, messaging, group chat, cloud docs, calendar, video conferencing, attendance, approval, bots, tasks, email, OKR, minutes and admin. Event subscriptions and callbacks are supported, including long-connection mode. Official SDKs exist for Go, Python, Java and Node. No exact endpoint count was stated.
result.blocker: Per-tenant admin approval is needed for sensitive scopes. A multi-tenant public app needs ISV qualification and Lark review. Developer docs are partly Chinese-only. Region split (Lark vs Feishu domains) must be handled.
